summary: Attackers used a compromised legacy private key tied to an internal Polymarket rewards wallet to steal approximately seven hundred thousand dollars across multiple addresses. The breached wallet distributed promotional rewards and user funds and market systems were not affected.
user_mistake: failed to retire or rotate legacy administrative wallet credentials
prevention: Rotate and decommission old administrative keys/Require multisignature controls for operational wallets
classification_warning: mixed compromise origin not publicly confirmed
